description: Litecoin block summary by height or hash; omit both for the chain tip. When to use: an overview of an LTC block, fee totals, MWEB activity, or confirming which block a payment landed in. Do not use: to fetch a single payment (that is ltc_get_transaction). Returns: hash, height, time, confirmations, txs, size, weight, difficulty, previous/next hash, the first ten txids, MWEB summary, and block-stats (total fees, fee-rate percentiles, UTXO change).

blockhash.description: Block hash (optional; use instead of height)
